messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT detected — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in inference-east-1. incident_id=INC-20260315-2142. rolling 1m error rate 4.8% vs baseline 0.2%.
Maya K: paging @Jordan H (oncall). looks like traffic surge + downstream model timeout?
Jordan H: on it. seeing multi-pod errors 504/502. pulling logs now. any customer-facing pages?
Sam R: one customer reported degraded responses in staging and prod — support ticket #7891.
Jordan H: confirmed spike aligns with deploy window ~21:35. checking rollout and recent infra changes.
Priya S: I rolled the rollout window to canary-only at 21:30, but did not change routing. no explicit config flips.
Liam T: infra alert: GPU queue depth on cluster inference-east-1-c reached 320 (normal < 50).
Ava C: looks like continuous batching backlog + some slow tails.
Jordan H: mitigation step 1: scaling up inference-pool-east by +4 pods, increasing max_workers to 12. executing now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scale request accepted, 4 pods requested.
Maya K: while scaling, let's mute the noisy per-pod 5xx alerts to reduce paging spam — we still need a high-level service alert.
Jordan H: /mute alert rule: inference_pod_5xx_high (temporary) — adding 15m mute.
Priya S: confirming: we should keep the global "service 5xx > 1% over 5m" alert active.
Sam R: noted. I'm updating the customer-facing status page: "Investigating increased error rates on text generation; partial impact."
Liam T: after scale, queue depth dropped to 45 in ~90s. error rate trending down to 0.9% but still above baseline.
Jordan H: digging into logs — several pods show repeated KV cache eviction warnings then OOM-ish retry loops. suspect memory pressure after model version bump.
Ava C: rollback candidate: same model code at previous quantization profile. can we route traffic to previous model variant?
Priya S: we have model:v2-q4_old which is compatible. can do traffic split 100% to v2-q4_old. Will initiate if scaling doesn't fully recover in 5m.
Jordan H: agreed. for now continue scale + monitor. I'll start a short-lived Grafana panel collection for the retro (quick scratch dashboard). need metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, queue depth, GPU util, batch sizes, prefix cache hit rate.
Maya K: tagging this for post-incident: alert tuning (mute vs threshold), golden signals for inference endpoints, add drilldown panels per region/pool/pod.
Priya S: I'm taking ownership of the retrospective dashboard. I'll create a dedicated folder in Grafana: "incidents/inference/2026-03-15-feb/" and add panels. @Jordan H can you paste the queries you want?
Jordan H: will paste shortly. quick PromQL snippets: 
```promql
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5..",route="/v1/generate",region="east-1"}[1m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",route="/v1/generate",region="east-1"}[1m]))
```
for p95 latency (histogram):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
```
queue depth: `sum(inference_queue_length{cluster="inference-east-1-c"})`
GPU util: `avg(gpu_util_percent{cluster="inference-east-1-c"}) by (instance)`
batch size distribution: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le))`
cache hit rate: `sum(rate(prefix_kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(prefix_kv_cache_requests[5m]))`
Jordan H: include a panel that links to pod logs and the deploy commit id for easy drilldown.
Ava C: Nice. also add panels for model variant traffic split and QPS per variant.
Maya K: can we also add an "Alert noise" heatmap: alert_fires_by_rule over last 7d to help tuning?
Priya S: yes — will add a heatmap and a table of firing alerts with counts. We'll propose: change per-pod 5xx alert from 1m->5m, and from absolute count 5->10, but keep service-level 5xx% alert strict.
Liam T: +1. we should also add an annotation when we mute an alert or change thresholds for audit.
Sam R: I've added incident timeline entries to the status page: scale, mute, potential rollback. will update customer comms if we roll back.
Jordan H: error rate back to 0.15% after traffic drained and scale + cache warmed. I'll hold off rollback.
Maya K: handing off post-incident to @Priya S for dashboard + action items. Jordan, please add any configuration diffs to the incident ticket.
Priya S: will run a quick retro doc, create the Grafana folder, and post panel links here. ETA 1.5 hours.
Ava C: I'll follow up on quantization/kv cache changes with the model team — possible root cause.
Jordan H: closing the active page, monitoring for 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INCIDENT update: resolved status set by @Jordan H at 2026-03-15T21:55:10Z. incident_id=INC-20260315-2142.
Maya K: post-incident actions (to be tracked): 1) Create retro dashboard (Priya) 2) Propose alert threshold changes + annotation practice (Maya & Liam) 3) Model-team follow-up on KV cache memory profile (Ava) 4) Update runbook for rapid split-to-variant (Jordan) 5) Customer comms follow-up (Sam).
Priya S: noted. I'll create the dashboard with panels: "Service 5xx %", "p95 latency", "Queue depth (pool)", "GPU utilization (pod)", "Batch size P95", "Prefix cache hit rate", "Alert heatmap", and per-pod drilldown links.
Jordan H: FYI for the retro panels, please include a small text panel with the sequence of events and links to commits and logs. makes postmortem easier.
Maya K: awesome. thanks everyone, closing thread once dashboards + proposed alert changes are in the ticket.
Sam R: I'll post a short customer follow-up tomorrow morning after the retro.
Ava C: reaching out to model infra team now.
Priya S: posting Grafana folder link when ready: will reply in this thread.
